changelog: Share from the menu: Send any title to someone straight from the context menu.
Default server: Choose one and VEXORA remembers it.
Delete confirmation: You now confirm before removing items from a list.
Fixes: Discover grid, history row, trailers and more.

features.title: Context Menu
items: Share: Send a title to someone straight from the menu.
Default server: Set your preferred server from the menu and it is saved.

features.title: Delete Confirmation
items: Confirm before deleting: A prompt appears before you remove an item from any list.

features.title: Interface & Usability
items: Context menu now closes automatically when you scroll.

features.title: Bug Fixes & System Stability
items: Fixed the Discover grid layout and scrolling issues in the virtualized list.
Fixed the history row showing up empty after the app had been closed for a while.
Fixed high CPU usage caused by a trailer thumbnail that failed to load.
Fixed the context menu opening in the wrong place or off screen.
Fixed gallery downloads saving a broken image when the download failed.
Fixed a crash on titles with no related content.
